endpoint_semantics: Current endpoint descriptions apply to third-party delivery, require a fresh posting GET and describe asynchronous transitions.
express_evidence: https://dev.ozon.ru/start/449-RFBS-Express-Rabota-so-skladami-i-metodami-dostavki-cherez-Seller-API/ documents non-integrated Express using seller or third-party delivery separately from aggregator Express.
express_rule: Known non-integrated carrier plus an exact current non_int_* available_action, supported predecessor, exact fresh warehouse/method, factual event and existing policy guards are required. Missing or unknown advertised action is not permission. No universal ban or all-profile authorization follows from express alone.
conflicts: Contradictory known exact method/posting integration observations remove current capability and block outgoing actions; missing data alone is not a contradiction.
limitations: No real Express posting transition was observed by this evidence review.
Method lifecycle status is not a universal prohibition on handling existing postings.
